parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_events (event_id, source, event_type, service, environment, occurred_at, correlation_hint, severity_hint, metadata)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::timestamptz, $7, $8, $9::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT $1::text AS event_id, $3::text AS event_type, $10::text AS ingest_mode,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS accepted;

WITH e AS (
  SELECT * FROM ir_events WHERE event_id = $1
), opened_or_existing AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_incidents (service, environment, severity, state, correlation_key, latest_event_at, current_version, summary)
  SELECT service, environment, 'SEV-3', 'OPEN', COALESCE(NULLIF(correlation_hint, ''), event_id), occurred_at, metadata->>'version',
         left(COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->>'reason',''), NULLIF(metadata->>'message',''), event_type), 1500)
  FROM e WHERE event_type IN ('health.failed', 'checkout.failed')
  ON CONFLICT (service, environment) WHERE state NOT IN ('RECOVERED', 'RESOLVED')
  DO UPDATE SET latest_event_at = GREATEST(ir_incidents.latest_event_at, EXCLUDED.latest_event_at),
                current_version = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.current_version, ir_incidents.current_version),
                updated_at = NOW(), revision = ir_incidents.revision + 1
  RETURNING incident_id
), deployment_target AS (
  UPDATE ir_incidents i SET latest_event_at=GREATEST(i.latest_event_at,e.occurred_at),
    current_version=COALESCE(e.metadata->>'version',i.current_version),updated_at=NOW(),revision=i.revision+1
  FROM e WHERE e.event_type='deployment.completed' AND i.service=e.service AND i.environment=e.environment
    AND i.state NOT IN ('RECOVERED','RESOLVED')
    AND (i.correlation_key=e.correlation_hint OR abs(extract(epoch FROM (i.latest_event_at-e.occurred_at)))<=1800)
  RETURNING i.incident_id
), target AS (
  SELECT incident_id FROM opened_or_existing
  UNION ALL SELECT incident_id FROM deployment_target
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.incident_id FROM ir_incidents i CROSS JOIN e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'deployment.completed' AND i.service = e.service AND i.environment = e.environment
    AND i.state NOT IN ('RECOVERED', 'RESOLVED')
    AND (i.correlation_key = e.correlation_hint OR abs(extract(epoch FROM (i.latest_event_at - e.occurred_at))) <= 1800)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opened_or_existing) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deployment_target)
  ORDER BY incident_id LIMIT 1
), linked_current AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_incident_events (incident_id, event_id, relationship)
  SELECT target.incident_id, e.event_id, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'deployment.completed' THEN 'deployment_context'
                                                WHEN e.event_type = 'manual.test' THEN 'related' ELSE 'trigger' END
  FROM target CROSS JOIN e
  ON CONFLICT (incident_id, event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING incident_id
), linked_deployments AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_incident_events (incident_id, event_id, relationship)
  SELECT target.incident_id, d.event_id, 'deployment_context'
  FROM target CROSS JOIN e JOIN ir_events d ON d.service = e.service AND d.environment = e.environment
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('health.failed', 'checkout.failed') AND d.event_type = 'deployment.completed'
    AND d.occurred_at <= e.occurred_at AND d.occurred_at >= e.occurred_at - interval '30 minutes'
  ON CONFLICT (incident_id, event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING incident_id
)
SELECT e.event_id, e.event_type, $2::text AS ingest_mode, true AS accepted,
       (SELECT incident_id FROM target LIMIT 1) AS incident_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM linked_deployments) AS deployment_context_count
FROM e;

WITH event_row AS (
  SELECT e.*, $2::text AS ingest_mode, $3::text AS incident_id FROM ir_events e WHERE e.event_id = $1
), linked_evidence AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_evidence (incident_id, evidence_key, kind, summary, source_event_id, payload)
  SELECT ie.incident_id, 'E-' || substr(md5(ie.incident_id || ':' || linked.event_id), 1, 12), 'event',
         left(linked.event_type || ' for ' || linked.service || ' on ' || COALESCE(linked.metadata->>'version','unknown version') || ': ' ||
              COALESCE(NULLIF(linked.metadata->>'reason',''), NULLIF(linked.metadata->>'message',''), COALESCE(linked.metadata->>'outcome','signal recorded')), 1900),
         linked.event_id, jsonb_build_object('event_id', linked.event_id, 'source', linked.source, 'event_type', linked.event_type,
              'occurred_at', linked.occurred_at, 'correlation_hint', linked.correlation_hint, 'metadata', linked.metadata)
  FROM event_row current_event JOIN ir_incident_events ie ON ie.incident_id=current_event.incident_id
  JOIN ir_events linked ON linked.event_id=ie.event_id
  ON CONFLICT (incident_id, evidence_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING incident_id
), signal_counts AS (
  SELECT i.incident_id, COALESCE(bool_or(e.event_type='health.failed'),false) AS has_health_failure,
         COALESCE(bool_or(e.event_type='checkout.failed'),false) AS has_checkout_failure,
         COALESCE(bool_or(e.source='manual.test' AND e.metadata->>'impact_scope'='complete_outage'),false) AS broad_outage
  FROM ir_incidents i LEFT JOIN ir_incident_events ie ON ie.incident_id=i.incident_id
  LEFT JOIN ir_events e ON e.event_id=ie.event_id
  WHERE i.incident_id=(SELECT incident_id FROM event_row)
  GROUP BY i.incident_id
), transitioned AS (
  UPDATE ir_incidents i SET
    state = CASE WHEN i.state IN ('OPEN','WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL') THEN 'INVESTIGATING' ELSE i.state END,
    severity = CASE WHEN signal_counts.broad_outage THEN 'SEV-1'
                     WHEN signal_counts.has_health_failure AND signal_counts.has_checkout_failure THEN 'SEV-2' ELSE 'SEV-3' END,
    current_version = COALESCE((SELECT metadata->>'version' FROM event_row), i.current_version),
    healthy_version = COALESCE(i.healthy_version, (
      SELECT d.metadata->>'version' FROM ir_incident_events prior
      JOIN ir_events d ON d.event_id=prior.event_id
      WHERE prior.incident_id=i.incident_id AND d.event_type='deployment.completed'
        AND d.metadata->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM i.current_version
      ORDER BY d.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1
    )),
    updated_at=NOW()
  FROM signal_counts WHERE i.incident_id=signal_counts.incident_id
    AND i.state IN ('OPEN','INVESTIGATING','WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL','NEEDS_ATTENTION')
  RETURNING i.incident_id, i.service, i.environment, i.severity, i.state, i.revision, i.current_version, i.healthy_version
), cancelled_proposals AS (
  UPDATE ir_proposals p SET status='CANCELLED' FROM transitioned t
  WHERE p.incident_id=t.incident_id AND p.revision<t.revision AND p.status='PROPOSED'
  RETURNING p.proposal_id
), expired_approvals AS (
  UPDATE ir_approvals a SET status='EXPIRED' FROM cancelled_proposals p
  WHERE a.proposal_id=p.proposal_id AND a.status='PENDING'
  RETURNING a.approval_id
)
SELECT (SELECT event_id FROM event_row) AS event_id, (SELECT event_type FROM event_row) AS event_type,
       (SELECT ingest_mode FROM event_row) AS ingest_mode, (SELECT incident_id FROM event_row) AS incident_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM linked_evidence) AS evidence_added,
       transitioned.severity, transitioned.state, transitioned.revision, transitioned.current_version, transitioned.healthy_version,
       'accepted'::text AS status, true AS accepted
FROM (SELECT 1) base LEFT JOIN transitioned ON TRUE;

parameters.jsCode: return {json:{status:$json.status || 'accepted', accepted:true, duplicate:false, event_id:$json.event_id, event_type:$json.event_type, incident_id:$json.incident_id || null, severity:$json.severity || null, state:$json.state || null, revision:$json.revision || null, current_version:$json.current_version || null, healthy_version:$json.healthy_version || null, evidence_added:Number($json.evidence_added || 0)}};
